name: APAR Industries
review_scope: Completed bounded structural/financial case and conditional reverse valuation. Not a fully funded forecast or approved capital deployment.
structural_thesis: Grid capacity, reconductoring, specialized cables and transformer-fluid demand can reward qualification, field execution and product capability over a decade. Customer and partner records establish actual capability before the present cycle.
strongest_counter_thesis: Premiumization and international demand could make current high unit economics more durable, so a normalized profit base near INR1800cr and 20% long-term growth could make the current price attractive. That requires funded per-share growth, not extrapolation of metal prices or temporary oil spreads.
current_price_judgment: PASS_CURRENT_PRICE for a new five-year position. Maintain a ten-year structural case with observable operating and price conditions. Not an all-market cash view.
scenario_assumptions: Working case: INR1400cr assumed normalized starting PAT, 15% annual PAT growth, 25x exit, 20% payout and 0.3% annual dilution. The prior INR1200cr/8%/20x row is preserved as lower_growth. A separate profit_reset sensitivity starts from reported FY26 PAT of INR976.93cr with 8% growth and 20x exit, using the same payout and dilution. FY26 is an observable stress anchor, not an asserted sustainable normal. Gross nominal INR returns include assumed dividends and exclude personal tax and trading costs. Additional external equity funding is not modeled.

1_year: Commission new capacity and recover physical conductor volumes
Reconcile working capital and supplier finance as deliveries convert to cash
Assess ordinary unit margins after oil spreads and US tariff refund normalize
3_year: Earn adequate incremental returns on FY26/FY27 capital and QIP
Retain repeat customer qualifications and export/cable customers
Increase EPS and cumulative cash per share without recurrent large equity issues
5_year: Demonstrate profitable reconductoring and specialized exports through weaker commodity conditions
Reconcile reinvestment, financing, dividends and owner cash
Avoid dependence on a premium terminal multiple for the investment outcome
10_year: Prove institutional succession and continued new-product commercialization
Retain economic profit as technology and capacity diffuse
Replace original buildout demand with replacement, upgrades and new applications

decisive_unknowns: Sustainable unit margins after present commodity and freight disruption
Cash and incremental return from the enlarged capital base
Current supplier-finance split and growth funding over a full cycle

comparators.name: Power Grid Corporation of India
comparators.structural_thesis: Commission and operate essential transmission capacity, funded over a long asset life.
comparators.strongest_counter_thesis: Most new work is competitive TBCB. Weak bid tariffs, cost overruns, commissioning delays or higher financing costs can reduce returns despite high investment.
comparators.current_price_judgment: Priority structural alternative at more moderate earnings valuation. Bounded comparator, not a completed BUY case.

key_metrics.caution: Reported rounded per-share inputs, no modeled project returns, dividend-payment confirmation or full capital-change sweep.

comparators.name: GE Vernova T&D India
comparators.structural_thesis: Qualified high-voltage systems, complex execution and a global manufacturing network.
comparators.strongest_counter_thesis: Current equipment margins and valuation can normalize as capacity and competition expand, with related-party exposure and contract risk.
comparators.current_price_judgment: Strong operating business, no purchase conclusion from bounded review.

limits: No portfolio sizing or transaction authorization
No retrospective buy or return claim
No full macro/market or personal-allocation evaluation in this subcase
POWERGRID and GVT&D are comparators, not full cases

review_correction.change: Renamed original downside case lower_growth and added a distinct profit-reset sensitivity.
review_correction.reason: The former downside starting PAT of INR1200cr already exceeded FY26 actual of INR976.93cr and did not capture a reset to that observed profit level.
review_correction.scope: Conditional sensitivity, no change to historical facts, normalized-profit uncertainty, working case, probabilities or current-price disposition.
